arguments.sql:
SELECT s.StatusType, s.FundingType, f."Academic Year", f."Charter Funding Type", COUNT(*) AS schools,
       COUNT(t.cds) AS sat_rows, COUNT(t.AvgScrRead + t.AvgScrMath + t.AvgScrWrite) AS scored,
       MIN(f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)") AS min_frpm, MAX(f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)") AS max_frpm,
       MIN(t.AvgScrRead) AS min_read, MAX(t.AvgScrRead) AS max_read,
       SUM(typeof(t.AvgScrRead) = 'text' OR typeof(t.AvgScrMath) = 'text' OR typeof(t.AvgScrWrite) = 'text') AS text_scores
FROM schools AS s
LEFT JOIN frpm AS f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
LEFT JOIN satscores AS t ON t.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.Charter = 1
GROUP BY s.StatusType, s.FundingType, f."Academic Year", f."Charter Funding Type"

arguments.sql:
SELECT
    s.FundingType AS funding_category,
    COUNT(*) AS active_charter_schools,
    SUM(f."Enrollment (K-12)") AS total_k12_enrollment,
    ROUND(100.0 * AVG(f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)"), 2) AS avg_frpm_eligible_pct,
    ROUND(AVG(t.AvgScrRead + t.AvgScrMath + t.AvgScrWrite), 2) AS avg_combined_sat
FROM schools AS s
LEFT JOIN frpm AS f
    ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
    AND f."Academic Year" = '2014-2015'
LEFT JOIN satscores AS t
    ON t.cds = s.CDSCode
    AND t.rtype = 'S'
WHERE s.StatusType = 'Active'
    AND s.Charter = 1
    AND s.FundingType IN ('Directly funded', 'Locally funded')
GROUP BY s.FundingType
ORDER BY s.FundingType
LIMIT 2
